subject: legend as grob in dev mode

messages.author: 4fdc04b06b76c8cf
messages.subject: legend as grob in dev mode
parts:
Hello,

I'd like to extract the legend of a plot to use it to show
a global legend with grid.arrange (or vplayout or whatever).

I need to work in the dev-mode and for my purpose I tried
the code from this blog:
http://blog.mckuhn.de/2009/09/learning-ggplot2-2d-plot-with.html

This code works well in normal but not in the dev mode of ggplot2.
In this case it seems that opts(keep= "legend_box") is not working correctly. It is not only the legend which is displayed, it is also the plot itself.
Is that a bug in the dev mode? Or will there be any other new function to
extract the legend as a grob in the new ggplot2?

/Johannes
